purpose: Bounded hypothetical-root feasibility, not benchmark membership or authorization
mula_docstring:
Creates a new mula-dhatu.

`aupadeshika` should be an SLP1 string and include anudatta and svarita accents as
necessary. For examples, see the dhatus in `dhatupatha.tsv`. (If you don't have this file,
consult the rest of our documentation for information on where to find it.)

examples.description: attested citation assigned an unlisted class
invented citation absent from this inventory
same spelling with explicit nasal it marker
same marked citation assigned another class

limitations: Absence is checked against 2,229 installed dictionary entries, not all Sanskrit literature.
Only Lat Kartari third-person singular is probed; no claim about other coordinates.
Engine trace 1.3.1 records its input assumption, not independent lexical attestation.
Full engine unions are preserved; linguistic and spelling completeness is not certified.
No task IDs, dictionary codes, meanings, splits, or synthetic benchmark families are fabricated.
